metadata.methodology: 5-phase formal predicate verification with attack vector analysis

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID correctly rejects invalid blocks without affecting persistent state

input_validation_bypass.finding: No bypass possible. Invalid blocks trigger api.invalid() at eth/catalyst/api.go:788,816,840 which returns INVALID status immediately.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Submit payload with incorrect state root expecting it to persist to database
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: InsertBlockWithoutSetHead uses transactional statedb; on failure all changes are discarded and INVALID returned with parent's latestValidHash

state_transition_violation.finding: State isolation maintained. Block execution uses copy of statedb; commit only occurs after successful validation. INVALID path never commits state.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Invalid blocks processed with bounded resources. Early rejection before full execution for structure errors. newPayloadLock prevents duplicate processing.

faulty_error_handling.finding: All error paths return INVALID status with appropriate latestValidHash for chain recovery. No error swallowing.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: newPayloadLock serializes all newPayload calls preventing race conditions during block validation.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Invalid blocks never corrupt persistent state; transactional processing with rollback on failure
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: @audit-ok annotation at line 727 confirms INVALID returned via api.invalid() when block validation fails

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE is only reachable from STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID

input_validation_bypass.finding: State commit is internal operation only reachable after InsertBlockWithoutSetHead succeeds with all validations passed.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Trigger state commit before block validation completes
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: InsertBlockWithoutSetHead executes all transactions, verifies state root, then commits atomically. Failure at any step prevents commit.

state_transition_violation.finding: State commit only occurs after computed state root matches expected root. MPT provides integrity verification on commit.
state_transition_violation.guard_location: core/state/statedb.go Commit() called from within blockchain insert after verification

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: State commit is bounded operation. Commit only after validation prevents DoS via invalid state commits.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Commit errors propagate correctly. Failed commit results in InsertBlockWithoutSetHead error which triggers INVALID response.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: State commit protected by blockchain mutex and newPayloadLock. Atomic commit prevents partial state.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: State committed only after complete validation; MPT provides cryptographic integrity verification
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: @audit-ok annotation at line 728 confirms state committed via InsertBlockWithoutSetHead after successful execution

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify STATE-EL-NEWPAYLOAD-RESPONSE-READY contains accurate payload status reflecting true validation result

input_validation_bypass.finding: Response status directly reflects validation outcome. VALID only returned at line 850 after successful InsertBlockWithoutSetHead.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Obtain VALID response for invalid block
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: VALID return at line 850 only reachable after successful block insertion. All error paths return INVALID via api.invalid()

state_transition_violation.finding: Status accurately reflects state. VALID=committed, INVALID=rejected, SYNCING=delayed, ACCEPTED=queued.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Response construction is O(1) operation after validation. No DoS vector.

faulty_error_handling.finding: All error paths set appropriate status. latestValidHash set for chain recovery on INVALID.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Response generated within newPayloadLock protected section. No race between validation and response.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Response status accurately reflects true validation result; no status confusion possible
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: @audit-ok annotation at line 729 confirms PayloadStatusV1 returned with accurate status

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD requires valid payload ID from authenticated prior request

input_validation_bypass.finding: GetPayload requires JWT authentication (Engine API namespace) and valid PayloadID from prior authenticated forkchoiceUpdated.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Retrieve payload without valid PayloadID
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: PayloadID lookup in localBlocks map. Unknown ID returns error. ID generated from authenticated request only.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload retrieval is read-only. Does not modify chain state. Returns built payload from authenticated build session.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: PayloadID enumeration protected by 8-byte random ID. Payload storage bounded with expiration.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Unknown PayloadID returns UnknownPayload error. No information leakage about valid IDs.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Payload retrieval uses mutex-protected map access. Build completion checked before return.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Payload retrieval requires valid ID from authenticated build request; no unauthorized access
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: GetPayload handlers registered under authenticated Engine API namespace with PayloadID validation

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-RETURNED contains valid, correctly-formed execution payload

input_validation_bypass.finding: Payload built internally by trusted miner/worker using validated transactions from pending pool only.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Inject unvalidated transaction into built payload
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: Transaction selection from pool.Pending() which contains only validated transactions. Block hash computed from actual content.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload construction follows protocol rules. Header computed correctly with proper state root.
state_transition_violation.guard_location: miner/worker.go payload building with proper header computation

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Payload building respects block gas limit and blob limits. Resource bounded.
resource_exhaustion_dos.guard_location: miner/worker.go gas accounting during transaction selection

faulty_error_handling.finding: Build errors result in failed payload retrieval. Partial payloads never returned.
faulty_error_handling.guard_location: GetPayload returns error if build incomplete

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Payload building has proper synchronization. Retrieved payload is complete snapshot.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Returned payload contains only validated transactions with correctly computed headers
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: Payload built from pending pool (validated txs only) with proper block construction

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify STATE-USER-SUBMITTING-TX input is treated as untrusted and fully validated

input_validation_bypass.finding: All user-submitted transactions go through complete validation in ValidateTransaction (core/txpool/validation.go). No bypass path.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Submit malformed transaction that bypasses validation
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: ValidateTransaction at line 70-164 performs comprehensive checks: type, size, signature, gas, nonce limit, intrinsic gas, EIP-specific rules

state_transition_violation.finding: User transactions only reach pool after validation. Pool maintains validated transactions invariant.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Transaction size limit (128KB), gas limits, pool size limits provide DoS protection.

faulty_error_handling.finding: All validation failures return specific error codes. Invalid transactions rejected before pool addition.
faulty_error_handling.guard_location: ValidateTransaction returns descriptive errors for each check

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Transaction pool has proper mutex protection. Concurrent submissions handled safely.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: All user input treated as untrusted; comprehensive validation before acceptance
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: @audit-ok annotations at validation.go:62-69 confirm complete validation coverage

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX performs comprehensive transaction validation

input_validation_bypass.finding: ValidateTransaction + ValidateTransactionWithState provide complete validation: signature (line 125), size (line 80), gas (lines 101,110,138), nonce (lines 129,256), balance (lines 271-286), EIP-specific rules.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Submit transaction that passes some checks but not others
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: Sequential validation checks all return on first failure. No partial acceptance.

state_transition_violation.finding: Transaction validation ensures only valid state transitions accepted. Balance, nonce, gas checks prevent invalid state.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Cheap checks first (size, type) before expensive operations (signature recovery). DoS resistant ordering.
resource_exhaustion_dos.guard_location: validation.go:71-82 size/type checks before line 125 signature

faulty_error_handling.finding: Each validation check returns specific error type. Complete error propagation.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Validation uses consistent state snapshot. No TOCTOU between validation and addition.
race_conditions_concurrency.guard_location: StateDB passed to validation with proper synchronization

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Comprehensive validation: signature, nonce, balance, gas, EIP-specific rules all checked
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: @audit-ok annotations at validation.go:62-69 enumerate all validation checks

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify STATE-TX-REJECTED is terminal with no path to pool or block inclusion

input_validation_bypass.finding: Rejected transactions never added to pool. Validation failure returns error and terminates processing.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Rejected transaction somehow reaches pending pool
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: Pool addition methods (Add, add) return on validation error. No path from rejection to pool.

state_transition_violation.finding: Rejected transactions cause no state changes. Error returned immediately to caller.
state_transition_violation.guard_location: core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go Add/add methods return on error

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Rejected transactions consume minimal resources. Early rejection before expensive operations.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Rejection errors propagated to caller. API returns error response to user.
faulty_error_handling.guard_location: Error propagation through Add -> validateTx path

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Rejection is atomic. No race between validation and pool operations.
race_conditions_concurrency.guard_location: Pool mutex held during validation and addition

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Rejected transactions never enter pool or block; terminal state with no escape path
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: Return statements on validation error prevent any pool addition

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify STATE-TX-PENDING only contains validated transactions

input_validation_bypass.finding: Pending pool only accepts transactions that pass ValidateTransaction + ValidateTransactionWithState. All add paths include validation.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Add unvalidated transaction to pending pool
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: AddLocal/AddRemote call validateTx before pool addition. No internal injection path.

state_transition_violation.finding: Pool maintains invariant: all pending txs have valid signatures and pass basic validation.
state_transition_violation.guard_location: core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go add method with validateTx call

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Pool size bounded by GlobalSlots (5120 default). Eviction of lowest-priced transactions.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Validation errors prevent addition. Pool consistency maintained on error.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Pool mutex (mu sync.RWMutex) protects all pending map operations.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Pending pool contains only validated transactions; invariant maintained across all add paths
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: All pool addition methods call validateTx before inserting to pending map

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE only traversed after successful JWT validation

input_validation_bypass.finding: ForkchoiceUpdated registered under authenticated Engine API namespace. JWT middleware validates before handler execution.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Call forkchoiceUpdated without valid JWT token
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: node/jwt_handler.go validates JWT before request reaches handler. HTTP 401 on failure.

state_transition_violation.finding: Fork choice processing only reachable after JWT validation. Authentication is mandatory gate.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: JWT validation is lightweight. DoS via unauthenticated requests rejected early.

faulty_error_handling.finding: JWT failure returns HTTP 401 immediately. No processing of request body.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: JWT validation is per-request. No shared state between validation and handler.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: ForkchoiceUpdated only reachable with valid JWT; authentication mandatory
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: Register() at api.go:53 sets Authenticated: true for engine namespace

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD only traversed after successful JWT validation for newPayload

input_validation_bypass.finding: NewPayloadV1/V2/V3/V4 all registered under authenticated Engine API namespace. Same JWT gate as forkchoice.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Call newPayload without valid JWT
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: Engine API namespace requires JWT. node/jwt_handler.go validates HS256 signature and iat claim.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload processing only after authentication. No unauthenticated path to newPayload.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Unauthenticated requests rejected before payload parsing. DoS protection at auth layer.

faulty_error_handling.finding: JWT errors return 401 before any Engine API processing.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Per-request authentication. No race conditions.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: NewPayload only reachable with valid JWT; all versions (V1-V4) under authenticated namespace
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: @audit-ok at api.go:720 confirms newPayload only reachable via authenticated Engine API

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-JWT-INVALID leads to terminal rejection with no further processing

input_validation_bypass.finding: Invalid JWT triggers immediate HTTP 401 response. No Engine API handler execution.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Bypass authentication with malformed JWT
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: jwt.Parse validates signature and claims. WithValidMethods enforces HS256 only. iat within 60 seconds required.

state_transition_violation.finding: Rejected requests cause no state changes. Handler never invoked.
state_transition_violation.guard_location: node/jwt_handler.go ServeHTTP returns on validation failure

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Minimal resource consumption for rejection. JWT parsing is lightweight.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Consistent 401 Unauthorized response. No sensitive information leaked.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Rejection is atomic. Connection closed after 401.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Invalid JWT leads to terminal rejection; HTTP 401 returned with no further processing
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: node/jwt_handler.go:70 WithValidMethods(HS256), lines 82-85 iat validation, immediate return on failure

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-FORKCHOICE-CHECK-BLOCK transfers fork choice state to block existence verification

input_validation_bypass.finding: ForkchoiceUpdated extracts headBlockHash from request and verifies block existence in local database before processing.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Set head to non-existent block
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: Block lookup via GetBlock/HasBlock. Missing block triggers SYNCING status, not head update.

state_transition_violation.finding: Fork choice only accepted when head block exists locally. No update to non-existent block.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Database lookup is bounded. Hash-based retrieval is O(1).

faulty_error_handling.finding: Missing block returns SYNCING status for proper sync coordination.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: forkchoiceLock serializes forkchoice processing. Block lookup under lock.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Fork choice head hash verified against local chain before acceptance
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: Block lookup in forkchoiceUpdated before SetHead operations

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND correctly routes to SYNCING state when head block missing

input_validation_bypass.finding: Missing head block correctly identified and SYNCING status returned. No false positive or negative.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Trick node into accepting fork choice for missing block
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: GetBlock returns nil for missing block. nil check leads to SYNCING response.

state_transition_violation.finding: SYNCING response does not modify chain state. Allows CL to initiate proper sync.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: SYNCING response is lightweight. No resource exhaustion.

faulty_error_handling.finding: SYNCING response properly formatted per Engine API spec.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Block lookup under forkchoiceLock. No race between lookup and response.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Missing block correctly routes to SYNCING state for sync coordination
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: SYNCING response returned when block lookup fails

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD only traverses when block exists locally

input_validation_bypass.finding: SetHead only called when GetBlock returns non-nil block. Block retrieved from local database, not from request.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Set head to block that doesn't exist locally
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: nil check after GetBlock. Non-nil block required for SetCanonical call.

state_transition_violation.finding: Canonical head only set to verified, locally-present blocks. Block data from database, not request.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: SetHead is bounded operation. Only processes existing blocks.

faulty_error_handling.finding: SetHead errors propagate to response. INVALID returned on failure.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: forkchoiceLock + blockchain chainmu provide proper synchronization.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Canonical head only set to blocks that exist locally and have been validated
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: Block retrieval from database before SetCanonical call

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-HEAD-SET-UPDATE-FINALIZED ensures proper sequencing of chain state updates

input_validation_bypass.finding: Finalized/safe updates occur after canonical head is set. Proper sequencing maintained.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Set finalized block that is not ancestor of head
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: SetFinalized validates finalized block is ancestor of head. Rejects invalid finality updates.

state_transition_violation.finding: Chain consistency invariant maintained: finalized <= safe <= head on canonical chain.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Finalized update is bounded. Ancestry check uses existing chain structure.
resource_exhaustion_dos.guard_location: Hash chain traversal is bounded by chain length

faulty_error_handling.finding: Invalid finality update rejected with error. No partial updates.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Updates under forkchoiceLock. Atomic update of finalized and safe together.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Proper sequencing: head set before finalized/safe; finalized is ancestor of head
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: SetFinalized called after SetCanonical with ancestry validation

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-CHECK-PAYLOAD-ATTRS only traverses when PayloadAttributes are provided

input_validation_bypass.finding: Block building only initiated when PayloadAttributes != nil. Explicit check before build trigger.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Trigger block building without PayloadAttributes
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: nil check on PayloadAttributes. nil triggers NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS path instead.

state_transition_violation.finding: Block building is explicit opt-in via PayloadAttributes. Not automatic.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Resource allocation for building only when explicitly requested.
resource_exhaustion_dos.guard_location: Build path gated by PayloadAttributes presence

faulty_error_handling.finding: Invalid PayloadAttributes return error. Valid attributes trigger build.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Check and build under forkchoiceLock. No race between check and build start.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Block building only when PayloadAttributes explicitly provided
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: nil check on PayloadAttributes before buildPayload call

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS handles forkchoiceUpdated without block building

input_validation_bypass.finding: nil PayloadAttributes correctly routes to response without building. PayloadID is nil in response.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Receive PayloadID when no building requested
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: PayloadID only set when building starts. nil attributes = nil PayloadID in response.

state_transition_violation.finding: Head update occurs without building. Pure chain state update path.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: No resources allocated for building. Immediate response after head update.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Response correctly formatted without PayloadID.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Under forkchoiceLock. No race between decision and response.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: ForkchoiceUpdated without PayloadAttributes does not trigger block building
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: nil PayloadAttributes leads to direct response without build

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-STARTED uses only validated transactions from pool

input_validation_bypass.finding: Payload building sources transactions from pool.Pending() which contains only validated transactions.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Inject unvalidated transaction into built block
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: Transactions come from pending pool only. Pool invariant: all pending txs validated.

state_transition_violation.finding: Built blocks contain validated transactions only. Pool maintains validation invariant.

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Transaction selection respects gas limit. Bounded transaction count.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Failed transactions skipped during building. Only successful txs included.

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: Pool snapshot used for building. Proper synchronization.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: Block building uses only pre-validated transactions from pending pool
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: pool.Pending() sourcing in miner/worker.go; pool invariant from validation.go

audit_findings.checklist_title: Verify EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-RESPONSE returns unique, valid PayloadID

input_validation_bypass.finding: PayloadID uniquely generated for each build request. ID required for retrieval.
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_attempted: Predict or enumerate PayloadIDs
input_validation_bypass.counterexample_blocked_by: PayloadID generated from timestamp, parent, feeRecipient, random, withdrawals. Cryptographically unique per request.

state_transition_violation.finding: PayloadID correctly associated with build session. Maps to specific payload.
state_transition_violation.guard_location: eth/catalyst/api.go localBlocks storage with PayloadID key

resource_exhaustion_dos.finding: Payload storage bounded. Old payloads expire. No unbounded growth.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Build failure returns error, not fake PayloadID. PayloadID only for successful builds.
faulty_error_handling.guard_location: Error handling in forkchoiceUpdated build path

race_conditions_concurrency.finding: PayloadID generation under forkchoiceLock. No duplicate ID risk.

guard_evaluation.invariant_preserved: PayloadID uniquely generated and correctly associated with build session
guard_evaluation.code_evidence: PayloadID generation from unique input parameters in forkchoiceUpdated

key_security_controls_verified: STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID: Transactional state isolation prevents corruption on invalid blocks
ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE: State committed only after complete validation with MPT integrity
STATE-EL-NEWPAYLOAD-RESPONSE-READY: Response status accurately reflects validation result
ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD: JWT auth + PayloadID validation prevents unauthorized access
STATE-TX-PENDING: Pool invariant maintains only validated transactions
EDGE-JWT-VALID-*: All Engine API endpoints behind JWT authentication gate
EDGE-JWT-INVALID: Terminal rejection with HTTP 401, no further processing
EDGE-FORKCHOICE-CHECK-BLOCK: Block existence verified before fork choice acceptance
EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-*: Block building uses validated transactions only
